- Registrable domain: `paypa1-secure-verify[.]com`
- Host: `paypa1-secure-verify[.]com`

## Assessment
The URL uses a leet‑spelled domain paypa1-secure-verify.com that does not resolve, indicating a newly registered or unregistered typosquatted domain. It serves over unencrypted HTTP and contains credential‑lure keywords (billing, secure, update, verify) with a high‑entropy session token. - `paypa1-secure-verify[.]com`

## Mitigation steps
1. DNS: sinkhole/block paypa1-secure-verify[.]com and all subdomains (*.paypa1-secure-verify[.]com).
